name: The Water That Climbs

levels.entry: Rain falls on the island top and runs off the edge, as rain does.
Under the rim it does not fall. It gathers on the underside and runs upward along it.
It leaves the underside at the island's lowest point and goes on going up, into cloud, and does not come back down here.
Moss grows on the underside in the direction the water climbs, which is the only way I can measure this when it is not raining.
Whatever holds the island up holds the water up as well, and lets go of it a hundred feet under. I can say where the boundary is to within a pace. I cannot say what it is.

notes: Aravali. Deliberately unresolved at the last rung -- the diary describes exactly and refuses to guess, which is the discipline this game is about.
